title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 48 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 48 - Separate Consideration of Speculative Business If any speculative business is carried on by any person, it shall be considered as separate and distinct business from the other business of that person. Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
